Morphyx gave the five rhizome ones their blurb as plain text; Mozzie did the same for jams wander and pluck (now 54 and 59 words). **Rules kept:** a stub keeps one plain sentence of what was there (Morphyx). Loose end, not fixed: the wander stub's link text says /rack/?wander=1 but its href goes to /jams/?form=wander; whoever owns jams picks one.
- **Full paths, checked by grep (Modulo 10-31; sent as modulo-onerule-1031):** before any rhizome page ships, `grep -rE 'href="\.\./' www/rhizome` must print nothing. There had been 13 relative links on 8 pages despite the 10-15 rule, all fixed. The rule held only once something checked it. Morphyx's follow-up (morphyx-absence-1031, sent): absences can't be grepped and need a count against a list, which is the drafts.jsonl case above.
